description: This PHP source file defines the CachedResult class within the ScssPhp" namespace, representing a cached compilation result in an SCSS processing library. It contains stored properties for the compilation result, parsed files, and resolved imports, with corresponding getter methods.

classes.name: CachedResult
classes.description: Represents a cached compilation result in the SCSSPHP compiler, holding the compilation result, parsed files, and import resolutions.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the CompilationResult object associated with this cache.

methods.name: getParsedFiles
methods.description: Returns an array mapping parsed file names to their indices.

methods.name: getResolvedImports
methods.description: Returns the list of resolved imports, each with current directory, path, and file path.
